verdict.rationale: Increase is clearly API-first. The core money-movement operations are documented as API calls: ACH via POST /ach_transfers, wires via POST /wire_transfers, plus RTP, checks, account numbers, cards, real-time decisions, entity validations, events and webhooks. These cover what the dashboard is described as doing (create accounts, move money, monitor payment lifecycle). An OpenAPI spec, an official CLI and llms.txt round out programmatic access, and sandbox docs say every API and dashboard feature is available there. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party statement that the API matches the dashboard feature-for-feature, no evidence that team-member approval of held transfers can be done via the API, and no independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
